title: Composition compatibility for section-normalized ordinary reindexing
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite field extension E of Q_l in universe u. Let A be a PodReindexFamily l E [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence]. Suppose its completion and tensor components satisfy PodCompletionReindex.Laws [def-pod-completion-reindex-models] and PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization] for every isomorphism between schemes on which l is invertible. If its composition comparison is the specified Over.mapComp restriction on every original local section, then A.Composition l E holds: its reduction, total-limit and completed-tensor comparisons satisfy the three composition equations of [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence]. Only this one comparison is required to be section-normalized; no other coherence law is assumed.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.

proof.text: Obtain the ambient total-limit composition equation from the strict restricted-tower, product and two-coordinate Roos normalization calculation.
Apply the proved adjunction transport calculation to the limit equation and the three Unit laws. This yields the reduction equation on every ambient object.

Use the completed-tensor normalization calculation for the tensor equation. For each composable pair, form the conjunction of the derived reduction equation, the ambient limit equation and this tensor equation; it is exactly A.Composition.

proof_origin.place: Step 2 implemented by adjunction Hom-equivalence injectivity and unit compatibility; Steps 1 and 3 isolated as the independent ambient-limit and completed-tensor equations. The original conclusion and hypotheses stay unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingCompositionCompatibility
    (A : PodReindexFamily l E)
    (hcompletion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f))
    (htensor : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E f (A.completion f) (A.tensor f))
    (hcomposition : ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V)
      [IsIso h] [IsIso f] (M : scalarReductionSource l E V) (U : Z.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (h ≫ f)).obj U))),
      ((A.composition h f).hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp (Q := ⊤)
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale h) (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale f)).inv.app U).op x) :
    A.Composition l E
